answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond on one timber-framed garden yarrow bed and files area and weighed yarrow. The auditor recomputes the harvest from the public yarrow yield table and checks the timber serial: one serial, one bed. Over 3% above the table, a reused serial, or a second bed under one key burns the bond. A rented-bed ring fails: the serial belongs to its owner, so the rented claim is rejected and the renter's bond burns. First filing 34 credits, kth 34+7(k-1), 1,000th 7,027; 1,000 fakes pay 3,530,500 and lock 80,000. An honest grower pays 34 once and recovers the bond.
